bands.name: Name

bands.conditionHint: If the condition fails, the band is not printed and takes no space.
bands.confirmDelete: Delete the "{{name}}" band and its elements?

fields.missing: This field is not in the catalog.

fieldList.title: Fields
fieldList.hint: Click a field to add it to the selected band, or drag it onto a band.
fieldList.itemHint: click, or drag onto a band
fieldList.arrayHint: Printed in a band that repeats {{array}}
fieldList.noBand: These fields are printed in a band that repeats {{array}}. Select a band and set its Repeat to {{array}} first.

check.title: Design check
check.summary: Errors: {{errors}}, warnings: {{warnings}} (checked with the sample data)
check.outsidePage: Past the paper edge: the right edge is at {{value}} mm, the printable width is {{limit}} mm.
check.outsideBand: Reaches below its band ({{value}} of {{limit}} mm) and prints over the next band.
check.textCut: The sample text does not fit: {{value}} mm wide, {{limit}} mm of room. “{{text}}”
check.linesCut: The sample text needs {{value}} lines; only {{limit}} are printed. “{{text}}”
check.barcodeCut: The barcode does not fit on the paper: {{value}} mm wide, {{limit}} mm of room.
check.missingField: {{path}} is not in the catalog, or its type does not fit here.
check.rootPrefix: {{path}} is a document field; in a repeating band it is bound as $.{{path}}.
check.noField: Field is chosen as content but no field is picked; the static text is printed instead.
check.emptyContent: The composed content has no text and no field, so nothing is printed.
check.noImage: No image is uploaded and no image field is chosen, so nothing is printed.

properties.formatHint: Printed in the filler's culture (tr-TR, en-US ...).
properties.magnificationHint: The QR size also depends on the length of its content.
properties.imageFieldHint: Leave empty to upload a fixed image below.
properties.thresholdHint: The image is converted to black and white with this threshold.

overflow.title: Overflow
overflow.growHint: The band grows by one line per extra line; elements below move down. Bold is not available.
overflow.charsPerLineHint: Estimated from the width when empty ({{n}}).

selection.alignTopOneBand: Aligning top edges needs elements of one band
selection.hint: Shift or Ctrl click to add to the selection, also from other bands; move them together with the arrow keys.

shortcuts.select: Add to or remove from the selection
shortcuts.copy: Copy, paste into the selected band

builder.title: Joins static text and fields in order
builder.empty: No parts yet. Add text or a field.
builder.truncateHint: Composed content is cut by each field's own "Maximum characters"; set overflow to "As is" or "Wrap".
